title: 紐澤西州 生活充實俱樂部 Living Well Club of New Jersey
content_html: The Living Well Club of New Jersey is a Taiwanese American senior social organization providing weekly gatherings in central New Jersey. Members meet every Wednesday from 10am to 3pm at the Taiwanese American Fellowship Presbyterian Church (TAFPC) at 100 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, NJ 08901, with a shared lunch provided. Activities span recreational, educational, cultural, social, and spiritual programs including bridge, chess, karaoke, Tai-Chi, Ping-Pong, arts and crafts, and occasional seminars and field trips. A second meeting location is Somerset Presbyterian Church, 100 John F Kennedy Blvd, Somerset, NJ 08873. Summer luncheons are held July–August at East Grand Buffet, East Brunswick, NJ.
